scene_description: A large wooden dining table is set for a Thanksgiving feast. A roasted turkey, bowls of fruit and vegetables, corn, meat, candles, and small pumpkins cover the table. Two young children are standing near the table. Several adults stand in the background holding wine glasses.

questions.question: What big food do you see on the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the large brown food at the front of the table.

questions.question: What is the girl on the right doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girl's arms and hands near the table.

questions.question: Where are the candles on the table?
sample_answers: in the middle of the table
verbal_choices: in the middle of the table
questions.evidence_hint: Look for the glowing lights on the table.

questions.question: What do we do with all this food on the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about why people put lots of food on a big table together.

questions.question: What might the family do next?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the food ready on the table and the people standing around it.

optional_extension_questions.question: What is your favorite food to eat at a big family dinner?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the different foods on the table and think about which one you like best.
